goal_checks.notes: Second open reads OPFS with no network — proven by opfs.test.ts and pdf.test.ts (getOrFetch calls the network fetcher once, then reads cache). Keyed per profile, per the confirmed NEW-1 answer.

pageWindow never returns more than 3 pages across a 30-page document at any cursor (page-window.test.ts, exhaustive over all 30 cursors); document-viewer.test.tsx confirms it renders exactly that window, centred on the cursor.

page-stage leaf has z0 canvas, z1 text layer (PDF.js's own TextLayer, real DOM spans), z2 empty Konva Stage host (hasPainter: false, matches the blueprint). Verified by typecheck against pdfjs-dist's types and the leaf's own tests; a real browser render of z1's selectability was not exercised (jsdom cannot run pdf.js's canvas/worker path) — noted in test.json as not covered.

Viewport slice (zoom/page/rotation) plus a Pointer-Events pinch/pan gesture in use-page-stage.ts: committed zoom only reaches Redux on the last pointer's pointerup, in-flight scale is a DOM transform via ref. Proven at the unit level (viewport-slice.test.ts, use-page-stage.test.ts); real touch/pen hardware was not exercised.
Exact round trip at 3 zooms x 4 rotations, plus a float-tolerance case at an arbitrary zoom (geometry.test.ts, 19 tests).

z0-z3 order followed; page windowing at ±1 page (§6.2); Pointer Events only, no mouse-only path (§7).

§5.3 storage tiers followed (OPFS for bytes, keyed per profile per the confirmed decision); navigator.storage.persist() called on load. §5.4 not yet touched by this task's code (capture/import is 010/011's scope).

canvas leaf shape followed (no *.painter.ts, since hasPainter:false); hazard 7 (200 live Stages) mitigated by g2; hazard 5 (viewport pixels) mitigated by routing all coordinates through shared/utils/geometry.
